scope: Two newly downloaded exact-model reference photographs for existing DSEI company records. No event participation or actual exhibition claim is added.
inventoryFinding: Eurosatory currently contains 64 company records and 9 products across 6 established vehicle-system companies. Requested additional large suppliers are not registered in that event shard, so these candidates use existing DSEI records.

verification.visualInspection: Both local JPEGs inspected with view_image. PIRANHA shows the Danish vehicle during a fording test. Bushmaster shows a complete front-quarter vehicle at the Australian War Memorial.

candidates.description: General Dynamics European Land Systems–Mowag의 PIRANHA 5 차륜형장갑차. 덴마크군 차량의 2017년 시험 사진으로 외형을 확인할 수 있습니다.
candidates.limitation: DSEI 2025의 실제 출품 여부와 전시 형상은 이 자료로 확인되지 않습니다. 사진의 도하 시험을 전 형상의 수륙양용 능력으로 확대하지 않습니다.
